entities.name: eIF4E
observations: The 209-residue query sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed Candida glabrata eIF4E accession Q9P974.
eIF4E binds the 7-methylguanosine cap of eukaryotic mRNA and promotes ribosome recruitment during translation initiation.
The protein contains an IF4E Pfam domain (PF01652) spanning residues 34–204.
Predicted molecular weight is 23.90 kDa and theoretical pI is 5.12; these are sequence-derived estimates.

entities.name: eIF4F complex
observations: eIF4E is a component of the eukaryotic eIF4F translation-initiation complex, together with eIF4A and eIF4G.

entities.name: Translation initiation
observations: eIF4E participates in cap-dependent translational initiation by recognizing the mRNA 5-prime cap and facilitating ribosome binding.

entities.name: Cytoplasm and nucleus
observations: Reviewed Saccharomyces cerevisiae eIF4E annotation places the protein in the cytoplasm and nucleus; eIF4E is also associated with cytoplasmic stress granules and the eIF4F complex.
